candidates.name: Avantic Residential
candidates.description: Avantic Residential is a leading, nationwide, multi-family residential investment and property management firm headquartered in Denver, Colorado. The Avantic approach is simple, to provide "best in class"​ property management service to our residents, clients and investment partners. As a rapidly growing company, we are always looking to match great talent with our varied career opportunities. If you are ready to join our A-Team we'd love to hear from you!
candidates.rationale: Same multifamily property management model, serving residents and institutional investment partners; comparable business and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Capreit
candidates.description: Founded in 1993, CAPREIT is widely regarded as one of the most trusted partners in the real estate industry. With executive offices in suburban Washington D.C. and Center City Philadelphia, our extensive industry experience allows us to provide a successful and enjoyable experience for our residents, investors, employees, and partners. We pride ourselves in our five Core Values that push us to be the best to our employees, our investors, our vendors and, most importantly, our residents.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily property management firms serving residents and institutional real estate owners; similar business model and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Avanti
candidates.description: Avanti Residential is a bold new move in multifamily. With a focus on people, community, and service we strive ever forward to be a best-in-class management company for both our employees and residents. Avanti Residential is an owner-operator of apartment communities throughout Colorado, Arizona, Utah, Kansas, and Florida. Be a part of something special. #SempreAvanti
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily residential property management firms serving apartment communities with similar operational and resident-experience focus.

candidates.name: Merion Residential
candidates.description: Merion Residential is committed to providing residents with a simplistic, hassle-free rental experience, owners and investors a solid return on their investment, and our employees a stable work environment and equal opportunity for learning and professional growth. Our communities are ideal for anyone and perfectly situated in the best neighborhoods. Our homes offer all the luxury and convenience one could desire. When you consider the wide array of community features available, you too will soon realize that Merion Residential properties truly are “Simply Apartment Living at its Best”. Whether you enjoy spending your time outdoors to foster a healthy, active lifestyle, or prefer relaxing at home to escape the busyness of everyday life, Merion Residential’s apartment communities offer the best of both worlds. Our communities feature unparalleled amenities designed with their residents in mind. Enjoy features such as bocce ball courts, fishing docks, cozy gas firepits, and heated salt-water pools. Our communities boast state of the art indoor and outdoor fitness centers, electric vehicle charging stations, yoga studios, resident lounges with coffee bars, and upscale outdoor kitchens. At every property, you will find our friendly and passionate leasing teams ready to assist you in making your apartment your home, as well as a responsive, on-site maintenance team, all eager to make your experience “Simply Apartment Living at its Best.”
candidates.rationale: Same multifamily property management business serving apartment communities and owners/investors; similar scale and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Prometheus
candidates.description: We began developing our first apartment building in the Bay Area in 1965. It was a garden apartment building with roomy floor plans, great landscaping, lakes, and a waterfall. Today, we've grown to over 13,000 apartments in and around the SF Bay Area, Seattle, and Portland. And that very first apartment building? It's still in our portfolio. To us, it represents our deep commitment to place-making investments inside and out to make your home feel charming, welcoming, inspiring, and enduring. When it says Prometheus on the door, you will always find friendly people and amazing neighborhoods, all with unique stories to tell. We are a B corporation, part of a group of companies that meets the highest standards for using business as a force for good. We have more than 500 Prometheans, and have a home office in San Mateo, with satellite offices in Portland, Oregon and in the Bay Area. We are a vertically integrated company with four main core competencies in-house: acquisitions/investments, development, value-add renovations and operations/property management. Prometheus has a long history of award-winning approaches to what we do, receiving over 100 awards for design and excellence including Fortune Magazine’s list of 100 Best Small & Medium Companies, the 100 Best Workplaces for Women and the Best Places to Work in the Bay Area.
candidates.rationale: Same multifamily apartment ownership/management model, similar customer base of institutional owners and residents.

candidates.name: The Morgan Group, Inc.
candidates.description: Morgan Group ("Morgan") is a vertically integrated, 3rd generation family business that invests in multifamily housing through development and acquisitions in high growth US markets. In its history, Morgan has built or acquired over $6.5 billion of multifamily communities, consisting of 30,000 units. Currently, Morgan’s owned and managed portfolio consists of more than 20,000 units across Texas, California, Missouri, and Florida. Morgan has been headquartered in Houston since 1959 and currently has regional offices in Austin, Dallas, and Miami. Over the years, Morgan has received several awards as a top workplace, including The Houston Chronicle, Great Place to Work and the National Apartment Association. Morgan has fostered valuable relationships and strategic partnerships throughout its 60+ year history and attributes much of its success to its family values and entrepreneurial, team-oriented culture.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily housing operators managing apartment communities for institutional owners; same customer base and operating model.

candidates.name: Simpson Property Group
candidates.description: Who We Are: Simpson Housing is a large, fully-integrated real estate company with an enthusiastic entrepreneurial spirit. For nearly 75 years, we have acquired, developed, built, and managed luxury apartment communities in highly desirable locations throughout the United States. We are driven by our Mission and Core Values and believe that our most valuable asset is our team. Our Mission: Simpson Housing is committed to be a trusted leader in the multifamily industry. Our mission is to provide an exceptional employee experience, award-winning customer service, long-term value to our investors and enhance our local communities.
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily apartment property management companies serving residents and institutional investors; Simpson is a close lookalike in model and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Presidium
candidates.description: Presidium is a Texas-based real estate developer, owner, and operator with a notable track record of creating significant value for our investors and enjoyable homes for our residents. We represent a spectrum of disciplines including acquisitions, development, construction, property management, asset management, law, finance, accounting, special servicing, and public-private partnerships. Our team is distinguished by the diversity, depth and character of our people. We are highly motivated individuals who have a unique willingness to work with, and for, each other. Presidium is always on the lookout for world-class visionaries to join our growing firm. If you're interested in joining the Presidium family, please reach out to us via email at careers@presidiumre.com. We look forward to hearing from you!
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily residential operators with property management focus serving apartment residents and institutional real estate stakeholders.

candidates.name: Elandis
candidates.description: Elandis is a real estate partnership between Libra Group, a privately owned, global business group whose subsidiaries have assets and operations in nearly 60 countries, and M&G Investments, a leading savings and investments business. Elandis’s investment model is based on the acquisition and repositioning of assets in certain high growth markets. We take advantage of our network of personal and professional relationships, along with local expertise and on-the-ground presence, to identify off market opportunities, establish alliances with third parties and deploy capital intelligently. US multifamily is our focus and passion. But Elandis has over fifteen years of experience as an owner and developer across the residential, office and hospitality sectors. Our varied and deep experience across sectors has informed and enriched our multifamily investment strategy. We continue to seek opportunities that meet our investment criteria. As an owner-operator, we actively target properties where we can improve both the asset and the overall community.
candidates.rationale: Both are US multifamily owner/operators focused on apartment communities, asset improvement, and resident experience for institutional residential assets.

candidates.name: W3 Luxury Living
candidates.description: W3 and our affiliate, N3, have owned, developed and managed more than 30,000 apartment homes that are operating (or are under development) in Dallas/Fort Worth, Austin, New Braunfels, San Antonio, and Houston, Texas. Our goal is to develop luxury showcase rental communities that host highly desirable exclusive lifestyles. Our mission is to build the highest quality apartment homes in the best locations with superior school districts, while maximizing views and amenities. We strive to provide exclusive “Ritz Carlton” service and the quality of a fine custom home at an affordable price. Every community we build is designed to be “The Best Place in the City,” and it’s easy to see why. W3 offers elegantly integrating interiors, architecture and high-end comforts into our cutting-edge designs. Residents become part of a members-only club with premier fitness facilities and pools, gracious gathering areas and business centers, billiard rooms, tanning beds and more. Our Estates and Luxe brand communities provide an elegant apartment living experience. The luxury-inspired Mansions brand affords our residents spacious rental townhomes providing a resort-style experience every day. Our stylish Towers properties offer chic, loft-inspired urban living with open floor plans and upgraded flooring, lighting and finishes. And because location is everything, we choose destinations that offer benefits like lakeside living, championship golf courses, and majestic forest and Hill Country views, as well as on-site private parks and jogging trails. Join the club! https://hralliance.net/apply/?catw3
candidates.rationale: Both are multifamily apartment operators managing rental communities for owners/residents; same industry and buyer persona.
